PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Connects the Handy speech to text application to the game, plugins, mods and scripts.
PluginData.Description:
1. Setup Handy and test it in a text editor: https://github.com/cjpais/Handy
2. In Handy's Settings, under Advanced / Output change the Paste Method to External Script or Webhook (if available), then copy the script path or the URL over from the plugin's configuration.
3. By default, the transcribed text goes to the mod communication channels and to the programmable blocks whose name matches, while pasting into the chat is off. Turn "Paste into chat" on in the configuration to get the text into the game's chat.
